description: A two-page document whose single sentence is split across the page boundary with no heading to signal a restart on page two. `assemble_reading_order` only reorders blocks within a page, so it has no mechanism to notice or stitch a sentence that continues onto the next page.

lines.text: This sentence deliberately continues on the next
